author: root
claims: For d>=6 and polar radical at most one over F2, nonradical nonsingular vectors span V and all symmetries act transitively on them.
No full isometry group in that range is generated by d nonidentity symmetries satisfying nonadjacent string commutation; IP is not needed for the exclusion.
With the complete reviewed two-page companion, the binary existence dimensions d>=3 are exactly3,4,5.
